notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.' Expectation from the text: on your turn Read the Tides draws three cards; only the second card drawn that turn triggers (one Cat, the third and fourth draws do not). 'Each turn' includes the opponent's turn: there you cast two Opts and draw your first and second card of that turn, so a second Cat. Total exactly 2.
